facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's reform progress report for 2025 lists the 'provision of internet facility for 21 LCs' and local area network installation at 21 local councils among the parts of the nationwide roll-out of PFM Smart, which it dates to the first quarter of 2026 and says was supported by the World Bank's Accountable Governance for Basic Service Delivery Project; it gives no separate date for the internet provision, names no provider and does not say who pays for the service afterwards.
facts.system: Internet facility for local councils under the PFM Smart roll-out

facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance states that PFM Smart, a web-based and real-time system upgraded from the councils' ex-post Petra accounting application, 'went live in all 21 local councils' during the first quarter of 2026, with go-live listed as the last step of a roll-out that included system deployment, user configuration and testing; it states transactions processed live, with payment instructions printed from the system, only for Freetown City Council in 2025, and says nothing of transactions at the other councils.

The Ministry of Finance states that in the first quarter of 2026 PFM Smart went live in all 21 local councils and that the roll-out provided an internet facility for 21 local councils and a local area network at 21 (21 of 21 by its own count); the same report elsewhere says 'all 22 councils' produced public investment plans, so its count of councils is not consistent.

The Ministry of Finance states that in 2025 the roll-out of the web-based PFM Smart was completed for one council, Freetown City Council, with transactions processed live and payment instructions printed from the system; end-user training in April 2025 had also been given to Western Area Rural District Council, and over 100 staff of 21 local councils were trained in November and December 2025, before the other councils went live.

The roll-out of PFM Smart to the local councils, with its internet facility and local area networks, is reported as the Ministry of Finance's own work: its Public Financial Management Reform Division with its Fiscal Decentralisation Division trained the councils' staff in November and December 2025, and the system went live in the first quarter of 2026.
facts.system: Internet facility for local councils under the PFM Smart roll-out

facts.fact: The report says the nationwide roll-out of PFM Smart in the first quarter of 2026, including the internet facility for 21 local councils, was supported by the Accountable Governance for Basic Service Delivery Project, a US$40 million World Bank project effective January 2022 and ending July 2027; it names no domestic budget line for the councils' internet.
facts.system: Internet facility for local councils under the PFM Smart roll-out

facts.fact: During the first quarter of 2026 PFM Smart went live in all 21 local councils, with an internet facility provided for 21 councils, a local area network installed at 21 and 500KV solar panels and batteries installed at 18, by the Ministry of Finance's report published in June 2026.
